headline: Compare full-campaign difficulty using a second objective-aware player

changes.title: Add an objective-aware simulated match player
changes.detail: The optional bot now independently ranks legal matches by pending objectives, urgent fuse penalties and special combinations without mutating game boards or changing live gameplay.

changes.title: Compare move selection on matched seeds with minimal booster use
changes.detail: Added 200 same-seed full-daily-wallet runs for objective-aware play plus 200 further runs allowing at most one emergency Hammer, preserving the original 2,000 greedy trials and earlier sparse booster samples.

changes.title: Report competing strategies with measured evidence
changes.detail: The diagnostics record chapter wins for baseline, goal-aware, and limited-Hammer play, actual Hammer uses and fallback swaps. Added deterministic tests and documentation clarifying that these are not human win rates.
